NVDA.gist: A stock in an uptrend; the buy is lower, at support (the November 2025 breakout level and the 200-day average); selling on the dip is light.

why: it broke down from a 4-week base

plan.sentence: Buy on a pullback to between −4.8% and −7% from the Oct 16 close. Target +2.3%, then +5.2%. Out on a daily close below −8.2%.

plan.why_zone: the November 2025 breakout level, the 200-day average and the Nov 10, 2025 high

standouts.head: Sitting on stacked support
standouts.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.
standouts.text: Price sits on the Oct 29, 2025 high, the October 2025 breakout level and the most-traded price of six months: 3 kinds of level at one price.

standouts.head: Weekly chart: advancing
standouts.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; the advancing stage (above a rising 30-week average) is where longs pay.
standouts.text: On the weekly chart price is above a rising 30-week average: the advancing stage.

standouts.head: Quiet selling on the dip
standouts.learn: A dip on light volume is profit-taking; a dip on heavy volume is selling.
standouts.text: Volume on the current pullback runs 17% below its 50-day average: profit-taking, not an exit.

NVDA.take: NVDA: it is pulling back inside an uptrend. Resistance +2.6% overhead leaves too little room from here. The better price is lower, at the November 2025 breakout level and the 200-day average. The weekly chart is in its advancing stage, and selling on the dip is light. Against it, it broke down from a 4-week base. The desk leans in, and sizes it small.
